title: BRANCH: Bypassing Multi-Scanner AI Guardrails
abstract: arXiv:2610.10742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) as core reasoning engines, making them targets for prompt injection and jailbreaks. Guardrails monitor and validate model inputs and outputs, yet their isolated, task-focused detection leaves gaps in their classification making them susceptible to bypasses. In response, guardrail systems formed by multiple scanners have emerged that collaboratively detect different types of malicious instructions, whereby shared latent representations across classification boundaries render established bypassing techniques ineffective. We propose BRANCH, a bypassing methodology designed for multi-scanner guardrail systems. translated_abstract: AI系统日益依赖大型语言模型（LLM）作为核心推理引擎，这使其成为提示注入和越狱攻击的目标。防护栏负责监控和验证模型的输入与输出，然而其孤立的、面向单一任务的检测方式在分类上留下了缺口，使其容易被绕过。为此，由多个扫描器组成的防护栏系统应运而生，它们协同检测不同类型的恶意指令，其中跨分类边界共享的潜在表示使得已有的绕过技术失效。我们提出了BRANCH，一种专为多扫描器防护栏系统设计的绕过方法。该方法利用分支树搜索策略，针对单个扫描器动态施加对抗性扰动，随后基于对所有防护栏系统扫描器的整体改进效果来进行扰动优化与技术选择。
tldr: 提出BRANCH方法，通过分支树搜索策略针对单个扫描器动态施加对抗性扰动，并基于所有扫描器的整体改进进行优化与技术选择，从而实现对多扫描器AI防护栏系统的有效绕过。
en_tdlr: BRANCH is a bypassing methodology for multi-scanner AI guardrail systems that employs a branching tree search to dynamically apply adversarial perturbations against individual scanners, with perturbation optimization and technique selection based on overall improvement across all scanners.
